subject: End-of-quarter timing — quick POC timeline check
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@horizonedge.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@horizonedge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: End-of-quarter timing — quick POC timeline check

Hi Lena / Mark —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum before quarter-end.

Recap (what we discussed):
- POC scope: evaluate Redwood Inference for production inference of your core recommendation model (up to 50 req/s, 1k token sequences).
- Success metrics: 95th percentile latency < 120ms, throughput >= 40 req/s, and cost-per-1k tokens under the target your team shared.
- Security: VPC deployment + KMS integration required for production.

Target timing we discussed: ideally complete POC validation by ~2026-11-10 so procurement can start early November and a production roll by mid-November if approved.

Immediate next steps (my side):
1) Share a one-page mutual action plan + POC checklist (attached).
2) Send a scoped estimate and an optional reserved capacity offer for predictable throughput.
3) Set up a short technical session with your infra/ML infra folks to review integration and network requirements.

Can you confirm whether the target procurement window (early Nov) still holds on your side and whether Nov 2–4 are available for the technical session?

If priorities shifted, tell me the preferred timeline and I’ll adjust the action plan.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood-poc-summary.pdf (POC checklist & timeline)

To confirm where we are: our leadership asked us to re-evaluate near-term spend; the POC is still a priority but the procurement timeline moved slightly. Current expectations on our side:
- Budget review complete by Nov 3. Procurement expects to open the PO window between Nov 4–8.
- We need a short tech alignment call with our ML infra and security on Nov 2–3 (prefer Nov 2 if possible).
- Please send an updated one-page SOW and the MSA or MSA summary we can share with procurement.

I can do Nov 2 at 11:00 AM ET. Mark (cc’d) will join the tech session and procurement will loop in the PO contact after the call.

Thanks —
